text:
Sophie L: quick sync — ran latebind + 4-bit quant on the new 13B candidate on hotpath. short story: ~1.8-2.0x token throughput, small quality delta on our QA suite.

Ajay K: nice. which quant and latebind config?

Maria P: ran with `q4_k_m` (custom horizon pack), latebind window=64, speculative depth=1. batch=8 on A100-80.

Sophie L: exact run: `model=redwood/13b-cand, quant=q4_k_m, latebind_window=64, spec_depth=1, temp=0.0, batch=8` — attached perf logs in the run artifact.

Maria P: perf summary (median over 5 runs):
```
- baseline fp16: 12.4 tok/s
- q4_k_m + latebind: 22.1 tok/s
- improvement: 1.78x
- 99p latency: baseline 420ms -> quant 460ms
```

Evan R: quality delta? any nll/perplexity shift on our long-context QA holdout?

Sophie L: short answer: small regresses on long multi-hop reasoning questions. aggregate EM down ~1.2% absolute on the 2k QA holdout. most regressions on questions >400 tokens context.

Ajay K: did you run the sampling stability checks? seed variance?

Maria P: timed 3 seeds on 200 examples: EM std ~0.35. not huge but higher than baseline. distribution shows more short, confident answers (over-pruning).

Sophie L: hypothesis: latebind + q4 reduces KV fidelity at tail of context => beam/sampling shift. can reproduce with `force_no_kv_opt` to confirm. also want to test `spec_depth=0` to isolate latebind effect.

Mike Ops: deploy-bot reports canary on 3 nodes finished: :white_check_mark: 1732468045 deploy-bot: canary complete (3/3). no infra errors.

Sophie L: next steps I propose:
- run 1k-example eval with long-context split (>512 tokens) comparing: fp16 baseline, q4 only, latebind only, q4+latebind.
- run `force_no_kv_opt` ablation to see KV-caused drift.
- run beam search (k=5) vs greedy to observe stability.

Ajay K: add adversarial prompts that exercise copy/recall across 1k+ contexts. also check logits by token to find where mass shifts.

Evan R: timeline?

Sophie L: I'll kick off the expanded eval today (ETA 24h). Maria will run `force_no_kv_opt` ablation. Ajay will craft adversarial set. Mike can monitor canary/infra.

Maria P: started ablation job: job id rwi-2024-173246-01. posting logs to /runs/rwi-2024-173246-01 in ~2h.

Ajay K: will push adversarial set to `/datasets/spec-adv-13b/longform-v1` by EOD.

Sophie L: good. if regressions persist we'll try tuned bias-correction on the KV read (small scalar smoothing) before rejecting quant+latebind.

Evan R: please capture eval config + deterministic seed in the job metadata. we should be able to repro exact deltas.

Sophie L: agreed. will attach `eval-config.json` with seeds, tokenization, scoring.

Mike Ops: FYI if perf holds we'll consider promoting to staging for a day of traffic shadow. otherwise hold.

Sophie L: thanks. tagging @Mike Ops for infra and @Ajay K for adversarial. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: scheduled job rwi-2024-173246-01 started (workers=12).
